message: Contract 'cre.lease' states none of rent, rent_year; type 'CRE.Contract.Lease' requires one of them.
CRE lease must state a rent: 'rent' (per period) or 'rent_year' (annual).
Contract 'cre.lease' states term 'growth', which type 'CRE.Contract.Lease' does not declare. The term would never be read.
hint: Terms of 'CRE.Contract.Lease': rent, rent_year, escalation, free_rent_months, lease_up_months.
